name: Build Apps
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:
jobs:
  build-android-apk:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 17
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - run: npm install
      - run: npm install @capacitor/core @capacitor/cli @capacitor/android

      - run: npx cap add android || true
      - run: npx cap sync
      - run: cd android && chmod +x gradlew && ./gradlew assembleDebug
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: implement-frontend-code-and-user-experience-userfriendly-interface-for-easy-tracking-and-management-android-apk
          path: android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/*.apk
  build-desktop-exe:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

          node-version: 20

      - run: npm install electron electron-builder --save-dev

        with:
          name: implement-frontend-code-and-user-experience-userfriendly-interface-for-easy-tracking-and-management-linux-exe
          path: dist/
  build-windows-exe:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - run: npm install

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: implement-frontend-code-and-user-experience-userfriendly-interface-for-easy-tracking-and-management-windows-exe
          path: dist/
